# OnExpire

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

What happens when a rule expires.

Appears at: `/rule_sets/rules/on_expire`.

## Variants

### `delete_after_days`

The rule is deleted this many days after it expires (1 to 3650):
it behaves as absent at once, and `crate::lifecycle::retire_due`
lists it for deletion once the days have passed.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delete_after_days` | integer | yes |  | 1 to 3650; format `uint16` | 1.0.0 |  |
